stem: If \(a\) is \(25\%\) of \(b\), where \(b > 0\), then \(b\) is what percent greater than \(a\)?
solution: \(b - a = 3a\), which is \(300\%\) of \(a\). So \(b\) is \(300\%\) greater than \(a\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(100\% - 25\%\), the percent by which \(a\) is less than \(b\). The question measures the difference as a percent of \(a\), the smaller number, so the answer is larger than \(100\%\).
explanation.B: Correct. \(b = 4a\), so \(b\) exceeds \(a\) by \(3a\), which is \(300\%\) of \(a\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(b\) is \(400\%\) of \(a\), but the amount by which it is greater is \(b - a = 3a\), or \(300\%\) of \(a\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the percent that \(a\) is of \(b\), not how much greater \(b\) is than \(a\).

verify:
b = symbols('b', positive=True)
a = Rational(25, 100)*b
ans = simplify((b - a)/a)
assert ans == 3
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
